attempted_claim: Let E/Q have CM by O_K for imaginary quadratic K, let p>=5 be inert in K with good reduction for E, let K_infty/K be the anticyclotomic Z_p-extension with layers K_n, Gamma=Gal(K_infty/K), Lambda=O[[Gamma]] with O the unramified quadratic extension of Z_p, and let epsilon in {+,-} be the sign of L(E/Q,s). Let Sel_str(K_infty,E[p^infty]) be the fine (= strict) Selmer group, X_str its Pontryagin dual, L_0 a characteristic element. With eta_0=rank E(K), eta_n=(rank E(K_n)-rank E(K_{n-1}))/p^{n-1}(p-1) for n>0, e_n=eta_n/2-1 if n has parity equal to epsilon, e_n=eta_n/2 otherwise, and Phi_n the n-th cyclotomic polynomial in Lambda, does L_0 = u prod_{n>=0, e_n>0} Phi_n^{e_n} hold up to a unit u in Lambda^times (empty product = 1), under Lei's normalizations in arXiv:2307.12053 Remark 3.12 Eq. (3.4)?
decisive_failure: Target requires settling open conjectures: anticyclotomic CM main-conjecture equality, exact fine-Selmer control with Sha-finiteness up the tower, vanishing of mu(X_str), and exclusion of non-cyclotomic prime divisors. Available theorems (Lei Thm 3.5, Agboola-Howard, BKO) give only divisibilities. No emergent finding was produced; no computation or citation within this pass can close that gap unconditionally.
